notes.title: It's been a week since we released DR3AMy on Steam 🪐
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840432/34babd103c3f9333d9675c7ae5e0f3ff47ad57d1.png[/img]

Hello.

It's been a week since we released DR3AMy on Steam!
I've been reading all the reviews you've been leaving. Thank you!
Also, to celebrate the release, the illustrator of DR3AMy drew a special illustration.
To be honest, I posted this mainly to show off the illustration lol

How cuteeeee

Have a great day!

안녕하세요, 여러분! <DR3AMy> 개발자 Ph0ton(포톤)입니다.

DR3AMy를 Steam에 런칭한 지 7일이 되었습니다!
유저 분들께서 작성해주신 리뷰 전부 잘 읽고 있습니다. 진심으로 감사합니다!

그리고, DR3AMy의 일러스트레이터 @Diml1ght 작가님께서 [b]런칭 기념 축전[/b]을 보내주셨습니다.
코튼, 카나, 에이미 너무 귀엽지 않나요?

늘 감사합니다. 

좋은 하루 되세요!

notes.title: We are launching DR3AMy! NOW! 🎉
notes.notes:
[b]🎉 We are launching DR3AMy! 🎉[/b]

Hello.

You can now play DR3AMy on its Steam store page. Right Now!
Due to a Steam error(?), it has launched earlier than expected!

I hope you have a great time with DR3AMy and Amy.

notes.title: Release schedule information for the Steam platform
notes.notes:
Hello.

I'm ph0ton, the developer of [b]<DR3AMy>[/b].

I've been informed that I can release DR3AMy files on Steam on January 31st (PST). You all will be able to play the game from 3:30 p.m. (Pacific Standard Time) on January 31st!

[u]*Please note that the release time may vary depending on your country![/u]

Thank you.
